mapper.insert:
insert into t_duihuan ( userId, lipin, shijian,
xingming, dizhi, dianhua, beizhu,
zt ) values ( #{userId}, #{lipin}, #{shijian},
#{xingming}, #{dizhi}, #{dianhua}, #{beizhu},
#{zt} )
mapper.update: update t_duihuan set xingming=#{xingming}, dizhi=#{dizhi}, dianhua=#{dianhua}, beizhu=#{beizhu}, zt=#{zt} where id= #{id}
mapper.select: select * from t_duihuan where xingming like "%" #{xingming} "%" order by id desc
